steps: In an empty project the new recipe entry opens guidance, offers no invented actor, disables Create, and writes no author data.

The ordinary World GUI creates an OC and then a compatible RPG player projection with size 72×88, speed 180 and blue color. Its source relationship points to that OC; no fixture author objects are injected.

A delayed real catalog read disables creation while leaving Cancel available; cancellation plus late reply never reopens it or writes data. Full JSON review retains symbolic game-projection inheritance instead of flattening size/color/speed/controls. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain fields/review, keep header and footer actions reachable, and allow source scrolling. Cancel changes neither author files nor editor state.

limitations: Actual Chrome with the local HTTP editor and trusted Godot. This acceptance does not install Tauri or exercise Android, native pickers, or other operating systems.

Only an empty org.viento.blank workspace is assembled before launch; the OC, compatible game projection, recipe and independent Scene2D are created through their actual GUI. Library project creation is not exercised.
Godot verifies built project and headless actor logic. Media import, authored behaviors, ZIP delivery, rendered gameplay and standalone executables retain their separate acceptance evidence.
